-- | Compiling Unison terms to ANF: closure conversion, lambda lifting and
--   the translation itself. The ANF it produces, and everything the
--   runtime does with it, is in <a>Unison.Runtime.ANF</a>.

floatGroup :: (Var v, Monoid a) => Map v Reference -> [(v, Term v a)] -> ([(v, Id)], [(Reference, FloatName v)], [(Reference, Term v a)], [(Reference, Term v a)])

module Unison.Runtime.Decompile
decompile :: Var v => (Reference -> Maybe Reference) -> (Word64 -> Word64 -> Maybe (Term v ())) -> Val -> DecompResult v
type DecompResult v = (Set DecompError, Term v ())
data DecompError
BadBool :: !Word64 -> DecompError
BadUnboxed :: !UnboxedTypeTag -> DecompError
BadForeign :: !Reference -> DecompError
BadData :: !Reference -> DecompError
BadPAp :: !Reference -> DecompError
UnkComb :: !Reference -> DecompError
UnkLocal :: !Reference -> !Word64 -> DecompError
Cont :: DecompError
Exn :: DecompError
Aff :: DecompError
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Unison.Runtime.Decompile.DecompError
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Unison.Runtime.Decompile.DecompError

module Unison.Runtime
type Runtime = Runtime Error DecompError
pattern Runtime :: forall {e} {e'} {v}. IO () -> (CodeLookup v IO () -> PrettyPrintEnv -> ProfileSpec -> Term v -> IO (Either e (Response e', Term v))) -> (CompileOpts -> CodeLookup v IO () -> PrettyPrintEnv -> Reference -> FilePath -> IO (Maybe e)) -> Type v Ann -> NESet (Type v Ann) -> Runtime e e' v
terminate :: Runtime e e' v -> IO ()
evaluate :: Runtime e e' v -> CodeLookup v IO () -> PrettyPrintEnv -> ProfileSpec -> Term v -> IO (Either e (Response e', Term v))
compileTo :: Runtime e e' v -> CompileOpts -> CodeLookup v IO () -> PrettyPrintEnv -> Reference -> FilePath -> IO (Maybe e)
mainType :: Runtime e e' v -> Type v Ann
ioTestTypes :: Runtime e e' v -> NESet (Type v Ann)
data Error

-- | <b>TODO</b>: This constructor should go away, but there are still a
--   few places that have unstructured errors.
UnstructuredError :: Text -> Error
CompileExn :: CompileExn -> Error
RuntimeExn :: Maybe (PrettyPrintEnv, Reference -> Reference, Val -> DecompResult Symbol) -> RuntimeExn -> Error
RuntimePanic :: PrettyPrintEnv -> (Val -> DecompResult Symbol) -> RuntimePanic -> Error


-- | Execute a computation of type '{IO} () that has been previously added
--   to the codebase, without setting up an interactive environment.
--   
--   This allows one to run standalone applications implemented in the
--   Unison language.
module Unison.Codebase.Execute
execute :: Codebase IO Symbol Ann -> Runtime Symbol -> ProjectPathNames -> IO (Either Error ())
codebaseToCodeLookup :: forall (m :: Type -> Type). MonadIO m => Codebase m Symbol Ann -> CodeLookup Symbol m Ann

module Unison.Runtime.Pattern
type DataSpec = Map Reference Either Cons Cons
splitPatterns :: Var v => DataSpec -> Term v -> Term v
builtinDataSpec :: DataSpec
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Unison.Runtime.Pattern.SeqMatch
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Monoid Unison.Runtime.Pattern.PType
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Unison.Runtime.Pattern.SeqMatch
instance GHC.Internal.Base.Semigroup Unison.Runtime.Pattern.PType
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show v => GHC.Internal.Show.Show (Unison.Runtime.Pattern.PatternMatrix v)
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show v => GHC.Internal.Show.Show (Unison.Runtime.Pattern.PatternRow v)
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show Unison.Runtime.Pattern.SeqMatch

module Unison.Runtime.Interface
startRuntime :: JIT -> Bool -> RuntimeHost -> IO (Runtime Symbol)
withRuntime :: MonadUnliftIO m => JIT -> Bool -> RuntimeHost -> (Runtime Symbol -> m a) -> m a
runStandalone :: JIT -> Bool -> StoredCache -> CombIx -> IO (Either Error ())

-- | A .uc file's program. A file without constructor names (one written
--   before they were added) reads with none.
decodeStandalone :: ByteString -> IO (Either String Compiled)

-- | A compiled program, as a .uc file holds it.
data Compiled
Compiled :: Text -> Text -> CombIx -> StoredCache -> ConstructorNames -> Compiled

-- | the version of Unison that compiled it, which only the same version
--   can run
[compiledVersion] :: Compiled -> Text

-- | the hash of its main term, abbreviated
[compiledMain] :: Compiled -> Text
[compiledEntry] :: Compiled -> CombIx
[compiledCode] :: Compiled -> StoredCache

-- | the codebase's names for the constructors of the types its code
--   mentions, for printing its values without the codebase
[compiledConstructorNames] :: Compiled -> ConstructorNames

-- | Whether the runtime is hosted within a persistent session or as a
--   one-off process. This affects the amount of clean-up and book-keeping
--   the runtime does.
data RuntimeHost
OneOff :: RuntimeHost
Persistent :: RuntimeHost
type Runtime = Runtime Error DecompError
terminate :: Runtime e e' v -> IO ()

-- | <b>NB</b>: The only reason this is in the unison-runtime package is
--   because it’s used in the tests. Otherwise it should move to
--   unison-cli.
prettyError :: Applicative f => (Word -> f (Pretty ColorText)) -> Error -> f (Pretty ColorText)
prettyRuntimeExn :: Applicative f => (Word -> f (Pretty ColorText)) -> RuntimeExn -> f (Pretty ColorText)
renderDecompError :: DecompError -> Pretty ColorText
tabulateErrors :: Set DecompError -> Pretty ColorText
instance (GHC.Classes.Ord from, GHC.Classes.Ord to) => GHC.Internal.Base.Monoid (Unison.Runtime.Interface.Remapping from to)
instance (GHC.Classes.Ord from, GHC.Classes.Ord to) => GHC.Internal.Base.Semigroup (Unison.Runtime.Interface.Remapping from to)
